description.value: A Subway sandwich franchise located in Trenant Park Square shopping centre in Delta, serving the Tsawwassen area. The restaurant offers the full Subway lineup of Footlongs, 6" subs, wraps, and salads with fresh-baked bread and is independently owned and operated. Touring cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen–Ladner corridor will find it a quick, reliable stop for a customizable, filling meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Subway franchise at 5263A 48th Ave, Delta, BC V4K 1W4 with phone (604) 940-0777 matching OSM. However, the OSM address field lists '5263 Ladner Trunk Road' while the website and URL slug both say '5263A 48th Ave' — a clear discrepancy to flag. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, though takeaway and vegetarian options are confirmed from OSM tags and website services list.
